activity.notes: Masémikensh was not a political ruler of all Yaghan people. Chilean cultural and ethnographic sources identify him as the Yaghan teacher who directed the final recorded Chiejaus initiation ceremony at Assif/Puerto Mejillones on Navarino Island in April 1923. ATLAS therefore uses active_in rather than rules.

sources.title: Memoria Chilena — Los Yámana / último Chiejaus
sources.citation_text: The Chilean National Library source states that the final Chiejaus was held at Assif in April 1923 and directed by Masémikensh, described as the last Yámana teacher.
